The Milwaukee Brewers have not been to a World Series since 1982, before I was even born.

I've watched the Green Bay Packers win Super Bowls, and I've watched the Milwaukee Bucks win the NBA Championship.

Please let this be our year.
ring cameras with football helmets replacing bud bowl has sapped my will to live. milwaukee bucks logo descent into fascism but much more devastating

The only thing crazier than the Milwaukee Bucks winning an NBA championship is the Milwaukee Brewers playing in the World Series.

#OnWisconsin

I got to cover & watch my hometown team make a World Series after 88 years. 

I watched the other side of town make one after 108 years.

I covered the Milwaukee Bucks getting to an NBA Finals after 47 years.

A dynasty would be fun…

But there's nothing quite like the first time, in a long time.

Game 1 of the World Series on Oct. 23.
The Milwaukee Brewers will be at home.
The Milwaukee Bucks will also be at home, hosting the Chicago Bulls for their home opener.
City attention will be elsewhere that night.
Giannis was such a monster back then.
